Definition: from G926 and G5092; highly valuable:--very precious.
BiblicalUsage: Barytimos means very precious, of great value, and it describes the alabaster box of very precious ointment poured on Jesus' head at Bethany.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the most precious thing in the room that night was not the ointment but the love that poured it, and the disciples who counted its price missed its point.
